subject: Offer call & preboarding timeline — contract clarifications
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Michael O'Neal <michael.oneal@gmail.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Feb 2028 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Offer conversation & quick pre-reads

Hi Michael —

Thanks again for your time over the last two weeks. We'd like to schedule a short call to walk through the formal offer and next steps (15–20 minutes). I attached the compensation summary and a draft offer letter for reference so you can come with any questions.

Are you available for a call on Monday 2/13 between 9:30–11:00 PT or 3:00–4:30 PT? If none of those work, send a couple slots that do.

Two quick notes:
- Start date: we're tentatively proposing March 6 to accommodate payroll and onboarding scheduling; we can be flexible within a 2–4 week window for notice periods.
- Contract redlines: if you have edits to the offer language, sign the letter or mark redlines in the PDF and we will route them to our People Ops / Legal review.

Attachments: offer_letter_draft_20280210.pdf (PDF — draft), comp_summary_20280210.xlsx (XLSX)

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0148

From: Michael O'Neal <michael.oneal@gmail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Feb 2028 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Offer conversation & quick pre-reads

Marissa —

Thanks, appreciate the docs. I can do Monday 2/13 at 9:30 PT — that works best.

A couple of quick questions before the call:
1) My current employer requires a four-week notice; is March 6 still feasible if I need to push to March 27?
2) On the equity vesting clause I noticed the standard one-year cliff. Is there any flexibility on accelerating the first vest tranche (I can outline why on the call).

I'll join the call at 9:30 PT and will review the PDF to see if any redlines are needed.

—Michael
Michael O'Neal
michael.oneal@gmail.com | +1 (650) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Feb 2028 07:45:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Offer conversation & quick pre-reads — candidate questions ahead of 9:30

Hi Karthik / Laura —

Looping you in ahead of my 9:30 PT call with Michael O'Neal (candidate for Sr. Infra SWE). He accepted the slot and has two items in advance:
1) Notice period — he may need to push start to ~Mar 27 (4-week notice).
2) Equity acceleration request — asking about moving some of the first tranche earlier.

Attachments include the draft offer and comp summary. If we approve a later start date, we should confirm his payroll pro-ration / benefits effective date with People Ops.

Quick asks: can Legal review the equity language if Michael marks redlines? If so, I want to tell him the expected review turnaround (target 2–3 business days). Also, if we accept Mar 27 as start, are there any manager-side blockers (project ramp / team kickoff) we should be aware of?

I'll capture your replies on the call and route any redlines via DocuSign / People Ops ticket.

Thanks —
Marissa

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Feb 2028 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FW: Offer conversation & quick pre-reads — candidate questions ahead of 9:30

Marissa —

Thanks for the heads up. I'm fine with March 27 as a start if that's what works for Michael — we can re-sequence the ramp tasks so key onboarding work is ready. Please confirm the candidate's notice period length during the call.

On the equity request: we usually don't accelerate the cliff broadly, but if the request is limited (e.g., shift cliff start or move a small initial tranche earlier) Legal has been amenable in isolated cases. Please request redlines and I'll approve a review. Aim to get any redlines to Legal before EOD Tuesday so we can keep the timeline tight.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Director, Infrastructure
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Michael O'Neal <michael.oneal@gmail.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Feb 2028 09:40:00 -0800
Subject: Offer call recap & DocuSign next steps

Hi Michael —

Great to speak this morning. Quick recap and next steps:

1) Start date — you shared a 4-week notice requirement; we are comfortable with March 27, 2028 as your start date. I confirmed with the hiring team and Karthik is ok with the shift.
2) Equity language — please mark any requested edits in the PDF (highlighted or annotations) or add comments in the DocuSign workflow. We will route redlines to People Ops / Legal; target turnaround is 2–3 business days once received.
3) DocuSign envelope — I sent the official package to your email. Envelope ID: ABC-ENVELOPE-12345. Link: https://www.docusign.com/en/track/ABC-ENVELOPE-12345

Attachments in the envelope: offer_letter_draft_20280210.pdf (sign or annotate), comp_summary_20280210.xlsx. If you have only small edits, feel free to annotate the PDF in DocuSign rather than requesting a full redline.

If you choose to mark any edits, I'll route them to Laura and Karthik and request Legal review. Also copying Laura to confirm payroll effective / benefits dates for a Mar 27 start.

Next: please sign or annotate the envelope; I will follow up once Legal reviews any changes.

Best,
Marissa

From: Michael O'Neal <michael.oneal@gmail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Feb 2028 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Offer call recap & DocuSign next steps

Marissa —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. I signed the signature pages in DocuSign and left two annotated comments on the equity section (see envelope notes). I also confirmed March 27 as my preferred start date.

Please let me know if Legal needs anything else from me. Looking forward to joining the team.

—Michael

References: DocuSign Envelope ABC-ENVELOPE-12345 (signed pages attached in DocuSign; annotations present)
